title: Perfecth
label: Matador
pull_quote: Nothing in this world is perfect, but everything seems to be 'perfecth'.
notes: Ninth studio album, 9 songs. Produced by Josh Homme and Michael Shuman. Earlier singles: 'Easy Street', 'Insignificant Other' (Aug. 25). Clear vinyl at indie shops; deluxe gatefold LP. Seed note re-verified.

title: The Holy Cross Tigers
label: Sub Pop
notes: Sub Pop debut and the New Orleans band's third album of 2026, after Blame the Clown (Chain Smoking, Jan.) and Florida Water Blues (Going Underground, July). 'When We First Met' runs 113 seconds; medieval-themed video. Seed note re-verified.

artist: Jozef Van Wissem & Jim Jarmusch (feat. Courtney Barnett)
title: Bocca di Lupo / Mouth of the Wolf
label: Sacred Bones
latest_single: Never Like You Said (feat. Courtney Barnett)
notes: Two albums released together as a 2xLP. Bocca di Lupo has 7 tracks, opening with a new version of 'Only Lovers Left Alive'; Mouth of the Wolf is 2 instrumentals. Barnett's vocals on the single were improvised in one take. Recorded at Fonoprint, Bologna, July 2025. Seed note re-verified. Barnett has no solo release coming; her album Creature of Habit came out March 27, 2026.

title: Dead Company
label: Warner
notes: Fifth album, 10 tracks, self-produced. First single 'Ten Over Ten' came out Aug. 12. Seed note re-verified.
